facts.text: Under its fixed-tuition policy, tuition remains locked for active students throughout their degree, and the Together Program allows alumni to audit courses for free after graduation.

sources.title: Adult Learners | Veterans & Working Adults | Nossi College of Art & Design
sources.quote: Our fixed-tuition policy means your tuition will never go up as long as you're an active student. Our Together Program lets you audit classes for free – stay fresh in your field of study long after graduation
